definitions.explanation: A smooth, shiny appearance on a surface.
An attractive, alluring quality, especially in appearance.

examples.english: Her hair has a nice sheen.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{漆器|しっき}→漆器：13329_shikki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{艶|つや}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
examples.english: This lacquerware has a beautiful luster.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{艶|つや}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あって→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{若|わか}く→若い：00823_wakai⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: Her skin has a glow that makes her look young.
To sing with a rich, alluring voice.

examples.japanese: ⟦{着物|きもの}→着物：01309_kimono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}た→着る：00541_kiru⟧⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なん}とも→なんとも：noentry⟧⟦{言|い}えない→言う：00515_iu⟧{艶|つや}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There was an indescribable allure about her in her kimono.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年|とし}→年：00486_toshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{重|かさ}ねて→重ねる：02039_kasaneru⟧⟦{艶|つや}やか→艶やか：22288_tsuyayaka⟧さ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ま}した→増す：02422_masu⟧⟦{女優|じょゆう}→女優：03353_joyuu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: She is an actress whose allure has only grown with age.

notes:
{艶|つや} describes a glossy, lustrous quality, often used for hair, skin, or polished surfaces.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {艶|つや}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (to have luster/sheen)
- {艶|つや}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (to lack luster, look dull)
- {艶|つや}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (to bring out the shine)
- ⟦{艶|つや}やか→艶やか：22288_tsuyayaka⟧ (glossy, lustrous) [na-adjective]
- {艶|つや}⟦{消|け}し→消す：00528_kesu⟧ (matte finish)

USAGE:
Often used to describe healthy-looking hair and skin, suggesting vitality and good health.
